purpose: Teach: 至急/台帳/雇い/シンクタンク/区民/区内/チームワーク/不明確

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 至急、本気で、絶対、対応、絶対、必要、絶対、案件、絶対、報告しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We need to handle this urgent case right away. Report on it immediately.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding tone. Sharp attack on first word. Businesslike and final. No room for question or hesitation. Shoulder-forward posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。在庫の、本気で、絶対、台帳、絶対、最新化、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're updating the inventory ledger right now. Thank you for the instruction.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Respectful but not obsequious. Slight pause before the thanks—acknowledgment, not flattery. Clear and competent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: パート、本気で、絶対、雇い入れ、絶対、慎重に、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: For the part-time hiring, proceed carefully. I want it done right.
lines.style: Direct and firm. Weight on 'carefully'—this is non-negotiable. Slower pace on the critical word. Business tone, but a hint of expectation beneath it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の、本気で、絶対、シンクタンク、絶対、ご意見、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're consulting with industry think tanks on this. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Steady confidence. Slightly higher inflection on 'think tanks'—showing initiative, not just compliance. Genuine, not performative gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、区民、絶対、向けの、絶対、サービス、絶対、強化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Strengthen our services for ward residents. Make it a priority.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding opening. Slight pause between the two sentences for emphasis. Lower register, definitive. No softness—this is an order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。区内、本気で、絶対、配送網、絶対、整備、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're building out the delivery network in the ward. Thank you for the direction.
lines.style: Calm, professional. Concrete details delivered without elaboration. Gratitude feels earned—responsive, not reflexive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 各部署の、本気で、絶対、チームワーク、絶対、強化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.style: Brief, clipped. Emphasis on 'all departments'—this isn't optional or negotiable. Final tone. No trailing off.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。指示が、本気で、絶対、不明確、絶対、な場合、絶対、確認、絶対、取らせております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. When instructions are unclear, we're checking for clarification before proceeding. Thank you.
lines.style: Careful, methodical delivery. Slight emphasis on 'clarification'—showing foresight and competence. Quiet professional assurance throughout.
